source_refs.note: Glycoproteins: a main subheading of 4.9 Conjugated molecules, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 127-127.

blocks.text: They are formed by covalent linkage between a protein and a carbohydrate polymer. They occur widely in nature as integral structural component of membranes; in blood serum; as cellular secretions; and in cartilage, eyes, skin etc.
